property_summary: After every admissible play (exact 10 wei ticket), c.pot() is always a multiple of TICKET_AMOUNT (10): a win pays everything out and resets pot to 0, a loss accumulates 10 — while the mutant leaves pot == 1 after a win, which is not a multiple of 10.
change_summary: Change win reset to pot = 1 so the pot retains a nonzero value after a win.
